Similarly, Ciwujianoside C1 also targets BT-474, which is also a target of Maesol, another compound that directly interacts with M-phase phosphoprotein 8. This suggests that Ciwujianoside C1 may act through a secondary pathway involving Maesol, further reinforcing the connection between the drug and the phosphoprotein. The evidence supports a mechanistic link between Ciwujianoside C1 and M-phase phosphoprotein 8, though the exact nature of the interaction remains to be fully elucidated.
